purpose: One retraining on D500 = D100 (preserved) + 400 new independent demonstrations. Development only: not calibration, not the final Test.

new_candidates.rule: source episodes in source-file order starting right after the last episode read by the Stage 1B conversion (position 130); a window of 420 is converted with the Stage 1B command and flags; the first 400 that pass the same replay success filter are adopted, the later ones are recorded as unused. Fewer than the required number stops the stage; the window is not extended silently.

d500.definition: D500 = old_train (100, copied from the preserved converted file) + first num_new adopted new demonstrations; ids traj_0..traj_499 in a train-only file
d500.never_trained: protected_dev (the 20 Stage 1B held-out demonstrations) and protected_remainder (the other converted demonstrations that were not in D100)
d500.initial_state_source: source trajectory.h5, env_states[0] of the source episode (not the converted file env_states[0])

training.init: from scratch (no warm start; the probe model is discarded)
training.changed_variable: the training demonstrations only; at a fixed update budget each demonstration is revisited about five times less often

selection.secondary: success_at_end (reported, never used for the choice)
selection.tag_note: tag i means i+1 optimizer updates for i < total; updates_completed is stored in each checkpoint

qualification.rule: the selected candidate only, once, after tensor parity and new-weights I/O parity pass
qualification.gate: >= 50/100 operational gate; 10-49 and 0-9 end the stage without further training

diagnostics.offline: same 100 histories x 4 noise seeds; RGB sensitivity (D4) not repeated

erratum_stage1c: The Stage 1C report says F-policy and R-policy agree in 39 of 40 pairs. The unit is scene pairs: 19 of 20 (traj_55 differs). The CSV is unchanged.

budget.note: recomputed from the actual rental price before training; never exceeded silently

stop_conditions: D100 payload identity or protected-set overlap check fails
observation/action meaning differs or the new-weights I/O parity fails
NaN/Inf, missing data, or an expert replay failure that cannot be explained
VRAM, disk or budget would be exceeded
